en.html:
Kageaki"...When heaven and earth first opened, the god who came into being in Takama-no-Hara was Ame-no-Minakanushi-no-Kami. Next, Takamimusubi-no-Kami. Next, Kamimusubi-no-Kami."
Kageaki"These three gods all came into being as solitary gods, and concealed themselves."
Hikaru"..."
Kageaki"Next, while the land was young, like floating oil, jellyfish-like and drifting, something sprouted and rose like a reed shoot. From it came Umashi-Ashikabi-Hikoji-no-Kami. Next, Ame-no-Tokotachi-no-Kami."
Kageaki"These two gods also came into being as solitary deities, and concealed themselves."
Hikaru"...Zzz..."
Kageaki"Hikaru."

景明「この二柱の神もまた、獨神と成りまして、 身を隠したまひき」
光「……すぅ……」
景明「光」

en.html:
Hikaru"Ow."
Kageaki"Listen properly."
Hikaru"To try to make an effort, in principle I have no objection."
Kageaki"One day Lady Subaru's place you will take, as the Minato priestess. Kojiki and Nihon Shoki at least you must learn properly. Otherwise later, what an embarrassment."
Hikaru"Bored..."
Kageaki"Boredom has to come. Until that much you have studied, how will it stay in your head?"
Hikaru"Only Yamato myths, all the time."
Kageaki"Naturally."
Hikaru"Sometimes a different story also I want."
Kageaki"Language and arithmetic you should learn properly from your teachers at school. For those, they are better than me."
Hikaru"Those fellows' talking I don't like. They go on and on. We are listening, not listening—koi farak nahin. They don't care."
Hikaru"Your voice I listen to, it feels nice, then I sleep. Those fellows' voices I don't like. So before listening itself, I sleep."
Kageaki"...Achha. That is why your marks are so poor?"

Kageaki"...And my lesson is not a lullaby service."
Hikaru"Ow..."
Kageaki"Chalo. We continue."
Hikaru"Different storyyy."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"What sort of story do you want?"
Hikaru"Hmm."
Hikaru"A story about different gods?"
Kageaki"Outside Yamato?"
Hikaru"Yes."
Kageaki"Country changes, mythology hardly changes. The gods' names, bas, those are different."
Kageaki"...No. Perhaps I have said a little too much there..."
Hikaru"For example?"
Kageaki"In Greek myth... first there was Chaos. From it came Gaia, Earth; Tartarus, the underworld; Eros, Love. Then Erebus, Darkness, and Nyx, Night. Darkness and Night produced Aether, Light, and Hemera, Day."
Kageaki"Gaia, Earth, gave birth to Uranus, Sky, and Pontus, Sea."
Hikaru"Ooh..."
Kageaki"Dekha? Same sort of thing, no?"
Hikaru"Not the same AT ALL."
Kageaki"...Hm? Well. Interpretation also is a factor..."
Hikaru"Continue."
Kageaki"...Uranus ruled the world. Gaia he took as his wife, and they had the Hecatoncheires, the hundred-handed giants, and the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants. But these children Sky did not like. Into Tartarus, the underworld, he threw them."
Hikaru"Cruel."

光「ひどい」

en.html:
Kageaki"After that, Uranus and Gaia had twelve Titans, the giant gods... But what Sky had done to the giants, Earth had not forgiven. She told the Titans: overthrow your father."
Kageaki"The youngest of the twelve, Cronus, the god of agriculture, did it. Then the same offence as his father he committed. His own son overthrew him in turn."
Kageaki"That son was Zeus, chief of the gods. With him as king, their golden age began."
Hikaru"Interesting."
Kageaki"Is it?"
Hikaru"More!"
Kageaki"Bas. Enough. Back to the Kojiki."
Hikaru"Moreee."
Kageaki"...Another time."
Hikaru"Hmph."
Kageaki"Pout all you want. Same answer."
Hikaru"Then a question."
Kageaki"What?"
Hikaru"Uranus and Gaia, together they became the rulers of their family, na?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Hikaru"But Gaia brought Uranus into the world?"
Kageaki"...That is right."
Hikaru"So the person who MADE him, over her also he claimed authority?"
Kageaki"That is what the story says."
Hikaru"Is that not forbidden?"
Kageaki"For humans."
Hikaru"Not for gods, then?"
Kageaki"...Gods must be having their own rules."
Hikaru"Hmm."
Kageaki"Now, back to the lesson."
Hikaru"Yeees..."

光「ふぅん」
景明「さぁ、勉強に戻るぞ」

en.html:
Hikaru"A human defies her mother and demands her father's recognition: against human rules. But gods have their own rules, and under those it is permitted. Toh? Everyone I shall defeat. Supreme might I shall prove. Beyond humanity I shall rise, and God I shall call myself."
Hikaru"Once I become God, my wish becomes justified. Break the human world, and Father is free of its rules also. Those same rules that bind him..."
Hikaru"Nothing left in the way! Hikaru can face Father! The father Mother took away, I can have him back!"

en.html:
Her father had broken human rules.
Therefore, father he could not be. Being her father, he had given that up.

Not necessarily his own wish. But this world's law would not recognise him as her father.

In the end, the law he obeyed. So never, as her father, would he appear before Hikaru.

Social order had taken her father away. One could put it that way.
If to get him back she became the destroyer of the world—then perhaps it was not madness. Perhaps a logic was there.

ja.html:
父は人の道に背き、
　<ruby>故<rt>ゆえ</rt></ruby>に父たり得ず、父たる事を捨てた。

　それは必ずしも父の本意ではなかった。
　しかしこの世の法が、父の父たる事を認めなかった。

　結局、父は法に従った。
　だから決して、父として光の前に現れる事はない。

　言うなれば光の父は、社会秩序に奪われた。
　光が父を欲して世界の破壊者たるのなら――確かに
それは狂気ではなく、道理なのかもしれない。

それは狂気ではなく、道理なのかもしれない。

en.html:
I thought of the suffering of that man, my adoptive father.

Since then, with what feelings had he lived? Regret... resignation?

And now, if Hikaru's wish reached him, what would he think? Her father she wanted back. For that, she had become Silver Star. Removed her mother, sought to destroy the world, to go beyond humanity and become God. To that farthest extreme of violence she had gone.

What would he think?

ja.html:
俺にとって養父である人の苦悩を思う。

　あの人はあれから、どんな想いを胸に宿して生きて
きたのだろう。
　後悔か……諦観か。

　そして今、光の望みを知ったなら、何を思うだろう。
　父を取り戻すという望みのために〝銀星号〟となり、
母を排除し世界を壊し、人を越えて、神たらんとする
――暴挙の極致へ至ったのだと知ったなら。

　何を思うか。

en.html:
What should I be thinking?

Back then, old enough to understand responsibility I had not been. But that excuse would not stand. Finally, the decision which erased Hikaru's father—and brought us to this day—was mine.

What should I think?
What should I do?

ja.html:
俺こそ、何を思うべきか。

　あの頃、俺は責任の意味を理解できる年齢に達して
いなかった。
　だがそれは弁明にならない。最終的に光の父を抹消
し――今日の事態を導いたのは、俺の決断であるから。

　何を思うべきか。
　何をするべきか。
